notes.title: 🚀 Big Update: Smoother and More Free Gameplay!
notes.content:
🔥 Big Update is Live! 🔥

Hello players! We've prepared a comprehensive update to make your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable. Here are the key improvements:

🖥 User Interface (UI) Improvements
The game UI has been simplified for a cleaner and more user-friendly experience.
Unnecessary elements have been removed for a smoother gameplay flow.
🎒 Inventory System Revamp
The inventory scene has been redesigned and reorganized for better usability.
The bag mechanic has been removed, making inventory management more intuitive.
🌍 Map and Floor System Updates
Floor transitions are now more dynamic and fluid.
Map boundaries have been removed, allowing players to explore freely.
A more seamless and engaging world experience is now available.
✨ XP and Gold Orbs Updated
XP and Gold orbs have been redesigned with improved visuals and effects.
Their visibility has been enhanced, making them easier for players to spot.
⚙️ Orb Movement Stabilization
The movement mechanics of XP and Gold orbs have been optimized.
Issues with erratic and unstable movement have been fixed.
Orbs now move toward the player more smoothly and naturally.
This update aims to make your gameplay experience more enjoyable and fluid. Don’t forget to share your feedback with us! 🎮

📢 Download the update now and experience the improvements! 🚀
